in_arabic.name: وفية

in_urdu.name: وفیہ
in_urdu.meaning: وفیہ کا مطلب ہے وفادار اور سچے وعدوں کو پورا کرنے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: وفیہ نام عربی جڑ و-ف-ی سے ماخوذ ہے، جو وعدوں اور پابندیوں کے وفاداری کے معنی میں ہے۔ اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام کسی ایسے شخص کے لئے استعمال ہوتا ہے جو اپنے وعدوں پر قائم رہتا ہے اور سچائی اور ایمانداری کی صفات رکھتا ہے۔ عربی جڑ کے مشتقات قرآن کریم میں ایسے سیاق و سباق میں پائے جاتے ہیں جو اچھی نیت اور عہد وفاداری پر دلالت کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.meaning: वफ़िया का अर्थ है वफादार और सच्चे वादों को पूरा करने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: वफ़िया नाम अरबी जड़ व-फ-य से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है वादों और प्रतिबद्धताओं के प्रति वफादार। इस्लामी संस्कृति में, इस नाम का उपयोग उस व्यक्ति के लिए किया जाता है जो अपने वादों पर खड़ा रहता है और सच्चाई और ईमानदारी के गुणों को धारण करता है। अरबी जड़ के व्युत्पन्न कुरआन में उन संदर्भों में पाए जाते हैं जो अच्छी निष्ठा और वादों के पालन को दर्शाते हैं।

in_english.name: Wafiyya
in_english.meaning: Wafiyya means loyal and true to promises and commitments
in_english.long_meaning: The name Wafiyya is derived from the Arabic root و-ف-ي (w-f-y), which signifies loyalty, commitment, and being true to one's promises. In Islamic culture, Wafiyya is used to describe an individual who adheres to their pledges and is characterized by honesty and integrity. The root's derivatives appear in the Quran in contexts that emphasize good faith and fulfillment of commitments, reflecting the importance of trustworthiness and reliability in Islam.

This name has been bestowed upon both men and women and is a source of immense pride and honor within families and communities. The annual commemoration of Prophet Muhammad's migration to Medina, known as Hijra, is a reminder of the importance of being faithful to one's beliefs, community, and values.

The term "wajib" in Arabic, which means "obligatory," shares the same root as the name Wafiyya, underlining the spiritual importance of being loyal and faithful to Allah and His religion. By living up to the name Wafiyya, individuals are reminded to strive for excellence in their worship, character, and personal conduct, all while upholding the values of mental, emotional, and social well-being. Ultimately, the spiritual significance of the name Wafiyya embodies the idea of a faithful servant of Allah, who strives to remain steadfast in their faith and actions, both in private and in public, and seeks to embody the best of human qualities as guided by Islamic teachings.
